# Toy-only evaluation photograph sources

24 reduced licensed public toy photographs; reviewed 14 October 2026. No customer/family uploads, people or identifiable family details. Only reduced re-encoded fixtures are committed; original downloads are discarded after preparation. The canonical manifest contains labels, source/license, derivative changes, review criteria and reduced-byte hashes.

Sources were verified using Commons per-file licensing metadata and visual toy-only review. Licensing permits sharing/adaptation subject to attribution and applicable share-alike conditions; each derivative keeps its listed license. This does not certify manufacturer safety, imply endorsement or claim legal review. A candidate with a child, a real animal, uncertain household utensils and an incompletely credited public-domain photo were excluded.

Known lead, small-part, magnet and uncertain historic/ride-on cases are recognition-only. Ages are invented parameters, not manufacturer recommendations. Coverage gaps: open battery compartments, damaged sharp edges and long cords; these remain mocked safety cases, not supplied live photographs.
